item.text: {"brief_complete":false,"completion_reason":"Three material architecture and integration decisions remain unresolved.","questions":[{"decision_key":"provider_eligibility_contract","label":"Provider eligibility","context":"Queue groups span direct, LAN mesh, and PeerJS providers.","question":"When is a provider eligible to receive a lease?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Require healthy heartbeat, capability match, capacity, and trusted endpoint policy."},{"number":2,"text":"Require heartbeat and capability match only."},{"number":3,"text":"Allow any configured provider; fail and retry at runtime."}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":96},{"decision_key":"workflow_memory_promotion_gate","label":"Memory promotion","context":"Execution memory is isolated; only validated records may enter versioned workflow memory.","question":"What authorizes promotion into workflow memory?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Validation passes plus explicit approval, recorded as an immutable Run event."},{"number":2,"text":"Validation passes automatically; approval is optional."},{"number":3,"text":"Workflow stage policy alone decides automatic or approval-gated promotion."}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":94},{"decision_key":"lease_coordinator_ownership","label":"Lease ownership","context":"FIFO atomic leases must remain consistent across heterogeneous provider transports.","question":"Where should queue ordering and lease state be authoritative?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"NexusCentral alone owns durable ordering, leases, expiry, and retries."},{"number":2,"text":"Each Router group owns its own durable lease ledger."},{"number":3,"text":"Providers coordinate leases; NexusCentral only records outcomes."}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":91}]}
